blind.description: A terracotta flowerpot complete with an attached saucer, filled with green foliage and clusters of bright red flowering blossoms (geraniums). The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous, with well-formed leaves and flower petals sitting neatly inside the pot, and the base rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A compact round cluster of bright red flower petals interspersed with dark green leaves, casting a textured shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall and 1 foot wide, roughly one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
